tasks.short: Compile test information and assess operating efficiency or malfunctions

steps.what: Select and verify test information, operating context and calculation inputs
Compile test information into matched tables, fixed efficiency calculations and trend charts
Check compiled data and analyze operating efficiency or diagnose equipment malfunctions

tasks.design: Configure reproducible tables, approved formulas and charts in {SPREADSHEET} from verified laboratory-record exports, represented by {OTHER}. The chemist retains input selection, quality checks and causal interpretation; calculations do not diagnose a malfunction.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated joining and charting of test and operating records consumes preparation time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native queries and checked formulas can reproduce fixed transformations.
tasks.still_hard: Poor calibration, sampling differences or operating changes can create misleading trends.
tasks.human_edge: The chemist distinguishes numerical association from a defensible chemical or equipment explanation.

ambition.what: Review a comparable efficiency trend for an additional routine operating period

tasks.altitude: Less compilation with unchanged diagnostic authority.

reach.task: Compare test trends against operating conditions

evidence.claim: The Instem account describes an Irish ISO17025 water laboratory replacing paper and spreadsheet processes with laboratory automation; it supplies no quantified saving for this chemist task.
The proposed compilation effort and net saving are E1 scenarios from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is compilation and interpretation of completed tests, excluding test execution, instrument maintenance and implementation of process changes.

Existing analysts and instruments produce test results and operators produce operating logs. Chemist s1 captures or verifies sample and equipment IDs, test time, operating interval, method version, result, unit, dilution, calibration and quality status, and formula version within30 hours; no quality flag is invented by the dashboard.

S1 explicitly resolves missing units, quality status and interval joins before compilation; unresolved items return to manual analysis. Test native laboratory export and spreadsheet query configuration before custom code.
Clinical or regulated release decisions remain separate. Additional source mapping maintenance is costed below.
unknowns: Export coverage, quality-status provenance and actual compilation effort
research_questions: Do reproducible tables match accepted analyses including all source verification, corrections and review time?

incremental.description: Calculation regression checks and mapping exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R70 gross30 minus5 focal upkeep gives net25. E1 repeat-analysis scenario; extra source correction lowers net to5-18 while scientific judgement remains fully counted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer with scientists and engineers on research analyses and tests

steps.what: Confer with scientists or engineers to interpret results and develop nonstandard research tests

tasks.design: Retain scientific discussion and joint reasoning. Existing evidence in {DOCS} supports the meeting; compiling it belongs to its own analysis task and is not counted again here.
tasks.previous_blocker: Nonstandard methods require shared expertise and challenge of assumptions.
tasks.enabler_now: Document tools can support the discussion without replacing collaboration.
tasks.still_hard: A proposed test may not isolate the intended chemical mechanism.
tasks.human_edge: The chemist challenges assumptions and integrates specialist feedback.
tasks.altitude: Collaboration time and scientific authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify chemical limitations of a proposed research test
reach.learn: Interdisciplinary test design and uncertainty communication

evidence.claim: Retaining scientific collaboration is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is the chemist's conference contribution, not colleagues' labour, separate data compilation or test execution.
Existing research work supplies questions and results; no structured scientifically-valid flag is presumed.
Keep current evidence access; no custom discussion tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; overlapping interpretation time is assigned once in roll-up.
research_questions: Which assumptions require joint testing before a nonstandard method is accepted?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; scientific discussion and joint reasoning retain full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Evaluate laboratory safety procedures against applicable standards and observed practice

tasks.design: Retain assessment of actual laboratory practice against standards and procedures in {DOCS}. No automatic compliant flag or generated safety verdict is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Documented procedures and actual hazards may differ.
tasks.enabler_now: Document access supports assessment without replacing observation and professional judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A written control may be impractical or fail under unusual conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The chemist recognises chemical and operational hazards that a checklist alone misses.
tasks.altitude: Safety evaluation time and decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Explain an observed gap between procedure and practice

evidence.claim: Retaining contextual laboratory safety evaluation is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is evaluation and recommendations, excluding procedure authorisation and implementation of controls.
Existing standards owners supply current requirements; chemist supplies observations with all time retained. No free structured hazard or compliance decision is assumed.
Keep current procedures and native document access; no custom safety system proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; confirm applicable national and sector requirements.
unknowns: Laboratory hazards, standards and responsibility for control changes
research_questions: Which controls differ materially between written procedure and observed practice?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; standards interpretation and observation remain fully counted.

tasks.short: Direct personnel in chemical test procedures

steps.what: Direct, coordinate or advise personnel in test procedures for components or material properties

tasks.design: Keep technical direction and observation with the chemist. Approved methods in {DOCS} support the work; a procedure document does not replace advice on actual samples and technique.
tasks.previous_blocker: Method application depends on sample conditions and worker understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Record tools do not replace technical supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Small deviations in preparation or technique can invalidate a result.
tasks.human_edge: The chemist notices technique problems and explains why a method must change or stop.
tasks.altitude: Technical supervision time and authority remain unchanged.

reach.learn: Observed technique assessment and corrective coaching

evidence.claim: Keeping contextual technical direction human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is chemist direction and advice, excluding technicians' test execution and method-development discussions owned by other tasks.
Existing method owners produce approved procedures; no structured safe-technique or valid-result flag is assumed.
Retain native method access; no custom supervision tool proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes; roll-up assigns shared conversations once.
unknowns: Personnel responsibility split and recurring method deviations
research_questions: Which test deviations require immediate chemist observation rather than written clarification?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0; technical direction and practical advice retain all time.

role.altitude: Reduce repeated test-data compilation while retaining chemical interpretation, safety evaluation and personnel direction.
reach: Explain observed safety gaps to safety specialists
